title: Dominoes on a Cracked Floor
description:
## Task

A floor is a grid of sound tiles (`.`) and cracked tiles (`#`). Dominoes of size 1 by 2 (either orientation) must cover every sound tile exactly once, never overlap, and never touch a cracked tile. Count the different ways to do it. Floors up to 8 by 8 occur, and an empty 8 by 8 floor has millions of tilings, so listing them one by one is too slow; remember partial results.

## Input

- `grid` — a list of equal-length strings of `.` and `#`.

## Output

The number of tilings. A floor with no sound tile has exactly 1 (the empty tiling).

## Example

```python
dominoes_on_a_cracked_floor(['..', '..'])  # returns 2
dominoes_on_a_cracked_floor(['...'])  # returns 0
dominoes_on_a_cracked_floor(['##'])  # returns 1
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ rows, columns ≤ 8
- The answer fits in a normal 64-bit integer.
